decisions.reason: The Aardwolf GMCP-handler broadcast maps directly to the native gmcp.comm.tick event and gmcp.comm.tick table.
Teardown removes namespaced event handlers, the repeating timer, and the UI object.
Plugin metadata maps to the source-project contract.
The discovered attribution is copied verbatim without inferring a license.
The broadcast relay is replaced with native GMCP handling; the miniwindow implementation needs visual review in Mudlet.
The GMCP-handler relay is replaced with a native gmcp.comm.tick event handler and table read.
The miniwindow calls require a Mudlet UI implementation and live visual review.
The second timer becomes a namespaced Mudlet timer with state owned by the timer package.
